summary: Safe Bulkers, Inc. filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on May 29, 2026, announcing the availability of its 2025 Sustainability Report. The report is prepared in accordance with GRI and SASB standards. No transaction, financial terms, or special-situation event is involved; it is a routine disclosure by the issuer of non-financial information. The filing does not relate to acquisitions, divestitures, activism, strategic changes, capital actions, restructuring, or other listed categories. Consequently, this filing is classified as not a special situation.
